BUILDER-ADVERTISED STARTING PRICEFrom $999,999*

Observed on DiGreen’s project page October 27, 2026. This is a community starting price, not a quote for either series or a specific model or lot.

Where is Navera at Mayfield Village?+

The builder identifies the community at Countryside Drive and Torbram Road in northeast Brampton, Ontario. The community intersection is separate from a confirmed sales office address.

What types of homes are planned?+

DiGreen is advertising 38 and 41 Series detached homes. Specific model dimensions, room counts and plan packages should be confirmed when released.

Are floor plans and deposits available?+

Detailed plans and deposit terms were not available on the builder page reviewed October 27, 2026. Contact Team Arora to request the latest available information.

What should I confirm about the price?+

Request a current model- and lot-specific price, including taxes, any rebate assumptions, premiums, additional charges, incentives and eligibility conditions. Prices and specifications can change without notice.

Does an enquiry reserve a home?+

No. Contacting Team Arora is an information request. It does not reserve a lot, guarantee an allocation or create an agreement to purchase.

Who operates this website?+

This independent brokerage website is operated by Team Arora, RE/MAX Real Estate Centre Inc., Brokerage. Team Arora does not represent DiGreen Homes.
